title: Print, then return
prompt: Write `add`, which prints "adding" and then returns its two parameters added together. `solve` returns add(a, b). Both the printed line and the returned value are checked.
starter:
func solve(a, b):
	return a + b
hints: A function can do things before it returns; returning is the last thing.

docs.name: return value
docs.what: Ends the function and hands value back to whoever called it.

docs.name: print(value)
docs.what: Shows value in the output. Takes anything; returns nothing.
